text:
maria: Heads up — while testing the v1 -> v2 migration for streaming, I hit two doc gaps we should fix before the soft-sunset: (1) SDK examples still use `onData` in TS/py snippets, should be `onChunk` in the v2 streaming examples; (2) we don't have a clear note about model fallback behavior and kv-cache mismatch when swapping streaming-optimized models. I'll open PRs for snippets and a small compatibility blurb. cc @sam @kevin

sam: Thanks — can you include a tiny TypeScript smoke snippet that shows the new callback name + structured output usage? e.g. how to parse JSON chunks from the stream. Happy to review.

kevin: I'll take the model fallback blurb. Where do you want it? Under "Compatibility" or a new troubleshooting section near "streaming"?

maria: Putting it under docs/guide/migration/compatibility.md (new subsection "Streaming model swaps"). PR link once created. Also adding a cross-link to runtime model aliasing doc so customers know fallback can change tokenization/kv cache behavior.

maria: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4123 — includes TS + Python snippets, a short note on kv cache mismatch, and a proposed deprecation banner for the streaming v1 path. Please review.

jordan: Looking now. Quick nit: python fenced blocks need the `python` language hint and we should demonstrate `async for chunk in stream:` parsing for structured outputs. Also add an explicit header example for `Content-Type: application/json` in the SDK raw HTTP example.

ashley (ci-bot): ci-bot: build failed for PR 4123 — docs/linkcheck: missing anchor `#kv-cache-behavior`.

maria: Got the anchor error, pushing a small anchor fix and adding an explicit internal anchor `#kv-cache-behavior` to the compatibility doc. Also added the `Content-Type` header example Jordan asked for.

sam: LGTM after those tiny fixes. One more ask: let's add a short deprecation banner at the top of the streaming migration page that points to the v2 streaming guidance and lists the SDK param rename. Should we schedule the banner deploy with the next site build?

ashley: I'll schedule the banner add as a separate PR to `_includes/deprecation-banner.md` and coordinate deploy with release notes. Tentative deploy: next docs site build (Tues).

kevin: Added fallback text and linked to runtime model aliasing doc. Also included an inline JS/TS example showing the recommended client call: `client.request({stream: true, model: 'redwood/stream-small'})` and a note about ensuring model variants are alias-compatible.

jordan: Approved PR 4123 with the python snippet change. CI still failing linkcheck: one reference uses `#model-aliases` but our anchor is `#model-aliasing`.

maria: Fixed that in a force-push, re-ran the linkcheck job. Also pushed a tiny example update showing how to fallback to a non-streaming model in the SDK:

```ts
// show fallback decision before opening stream
const model = preferStreaming ? 'redwood/stream-small' : 'redwood/text-small';
await client.request({ model, stream: preferStreaming, onChunk: (c) => parseJsonChunk(c) });
```

maria: Last ask — can QA run the smoke tests for both Dedicated and Hosted examples (esp. kv-cache behavior) once CI passes? tagging @eng-runtime-bot for a quick sanity check.

eng-runtime-bot: sched: docs-smoke/dedicated and docs-smoke/hosted queued for PR 4123; expect results in ~30m.

sam: Thanks everyone. Once CI/linkcheck passes and eng-runtime confirms smoke, I'll merge and we can flip the soft deprecation banner on Tuesday. :thumbsup:
